purpose: Acknowledge someone’s circumstances when interrupting or receiving help.
keywords: Vている / adjective / N + の + ところを
Thank you for coming despite being busy.
I am sorry to disturb you while you are resting.
They helped me when I was in difficulty.
formation: Vている / adjective / N + の + ところを
restrictions: Often with お忙しい, お休み, or a difficult situation.
mistake: The following action intrudes on or responds to that circumstance.
